meta.name: youtube-transcript
meta.description: Fetch, analyze, and summarize YouTube video transcripts. Use when the user wants to extract transcript from a YouTube video, summarize a video's content, or use video transcripts as coding context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取视频字幕并提炼核心内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想快速了解长视频的要点而无需完整观看
copy.tagline_en: Fetch video transcripts and generate concise summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to grasp key points of long videos without watching them fully.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以获取任意 YouTube 视频的完整转写文本(带不带时间戳可视需要),并据此总结视频内容、分析要点,或把转写内容当作编码上下文使用。
howto.when: 当用户要求提取某个 YouTube 视频的转写文本、总结该视频的内容,或把视频转写用作编码上下文时触发。

say.text: 总结这个视频讲了什么:https://youtu.be/xxxx
say.note: 会获取转写并生成总结。

say.text: 把这个教程视频的转写作为上下文,帮我实现里面的代码模式。
say.note: 转写会作为编码上下文使用。

howto.what_en: Fetches the full transcript of any YouTube video, then uses it to summarize, analyze, or provide coding context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to extract a YouTube video transcript, summarize a video's content, or use the transcript as coding context.

say_en.text: Fetch the transcript for this YouTube video: https://youtu.be/xxxx
say_en.note: Outputs plain-text transcript, defaulting to English.

say_en.text: Summarize what this video is about: https://youtu.be/xxxx
say_en.note: Fetches transcript and generates a summary.

say_en.text: Use this tutorial's transcript as context to implement the pattern shown.
say_en.note: Transcript is used as coding context.
